Changing Your Meal Plan

Meal plan changes are managed through Erezlife. Visit Erezlife to make changes to your meal plan.

Restricted Meal Plan – Block 120

Block 120 meal plans may only be chosen for the following reasons:

  • Living off campus, in a townhouse, or commuting.
  • Dietary restrictions confirmed with a doctor’s note.
  • Academic requirements such as clinicals, student teaching, or required off-campus internships.

If you meet one of these qualifications you may apply. You will be notified by email whether your request has been granted.

Apply for a Block 120 Plan
